node.title: Re^3: Unicode in one-liner
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [shawnhcorey],

perl -nC -E 'print "\N{BULLET} $_"' /usr/share/dict/words

Note that the automatic loading of [doc://charnames] was [doc://perl5160delta#use-charnames-is-no-longer-needed-for-\N{_name_}|added in v5.16]. For older versions of Perl, there's either [1nickt]'s one-liner, or:

perl -Mcharnames=:full -nC -E 'print "\N{BULLET} $_"' /usr/share/dict/words

Regards,
-- Hauke D
